issues.description: The problem statement text requires messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) (including a double parameter and a specific volume-based return format), but the UML earlier in the same problem statement and the provided solution/template use messageOnMilk() with no parameters. This mismatch will confuse students whether to implement a parameterized method (as described in the text) or a parameterless method (as in the UML, solution, and template usage), and will cause compilation/signature mismatches against the provided solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent: either (A) change the textual requirement in problem_statement.md to specify messageOnMilk() with no parameter and the non-volume return format (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), matching the UML and solution; or (B) update the UML, template usage (Main.java), and solution to declare messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and adapt all implementations and tests to accept the double parameter and return the volume-inclusive string. Option A is likely simpler and preserves the current solution/tests.
